solutions.title: In-place selection sort
solutions.strategy: Repeatedly select the smallest value from the unsorted suffix and swap it into place.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each index scans the remaining suffix to find the next smallest color.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Selection sort uses only loop indexes and a temporary swap variable.

solutions.title: Count and overwrite
solutions.strategy: Count the three color values, then overwrite the array with the right number of each color.

timeComplexity.explanation: The array is scanned once for counts and written once from those counts.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only three counters are stored regardless of input length.

solutions.title: Dutch national flag partition
solutions.strategy: Maintain low, mid, and high regions so zeroes move left, twos move right, and ones stay in the middle.

timeComplexity.explanation: The mid pointer advances or the high pointer retreats on every step, so each item is handled a constant number of times.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The algorithm uses three pointers and swaps in place.
